proof_attempt_summary: Discovery derived matching original-record minimax absolute-risk and 90%-honest connected-interval length orders max(n^(-2/7),n^(-4s/(4s+1))) for dose and max(n^(-3/7),n^(-4s/(4s+1))) for minimum value, with elbows 1/10 and 3/16 and no logarithmic loss. Independent math review passed after explicit finite-sample threshold closure; the novelty assessment remained subfield below the field floor, and the theorem-adjacent prior-class comparison remains unrepaired. tldr: For the marginal causal minimizing dose \(z\) and minimum event risk \(v\), the original-record minimax absolute-error and finite-sample honest-length scales coincide: \(r_z=\ell_z=\max\{n^{-2/7},n^{-4s/(4s+1)}\}\) and \(r_v=\ell_v=\max\{n^{-3/7},n^{-4s/(4s+1)}\}\). The distinct elbows are \(s=1/10\) and \(s=3/16\), with no logarithmic factor. A primitive sparse dose \(C^1\) pilot and observable cubic multiscale ratio correction attain the pointwise slope and height orders; independent median localization and value evaluation give attaining estimates and connected intervals honest at level \(0.90\) over the entire fixed class for every \(n\ge1\). Normalized joint assignment and Bernoulli-response alternatives provide the matching rough converse in the original likelihood. The stipulated all-dose bridge supplies the causal interpretation. The class \(\mathcal P_s\) is this note's binary, uniform-covariate, derivative-wise mixed class, rather than the estimator-level domain of Bonvini--Kennedy Theorem 3.1.
gap: Conditional causal-curve bounds and direct-observation extrema theory leave a primitive, rough-adjustment optimizer precision question unresolved. The causal interpretation is stipulated by the supplied model and contributes no identification advance.
